classification.limit: These workers pause for vmmap and therefore alter reclamation timing; they are resource attribution controls, not speed/RSS benchmark replacements. The formerly allocated range can later be reused; partial residual mappings are not assumed to hold the original allocation.

conclusions.reproduced_current_diagnostic: Two paired stage29 diagnostics reproduced about99-100MiB extra process peak RSS with reuse. Peak footprint increased similarly; compressed stayed0 for all four.
conclusions.not_algorithm_live_payload: Frame capacities and ordered matching work were exact to reference. Before pose, malloc live differed at most about0.14MiB while RSS differed about98-101MiB; the extra is not explained by the26KiB angle cache or extra live pose/image capacity.
conclusions.direct_origin_evidence: A pointer recorded from the 8192x4096 RGB888 QImage before destruction identified exactly100663296bytes (96MiB). After decoding this same region was MALLOC_LARGE(empty), with96MiB still resident and dirty, proving a freed image conversion buffer remained charged to the process.
conclusions.timing_overlap_evidence: Before first pose creation in the classification control, the reuse worker still had the full former96MiB RGB range resident/dirty as MALLOC_LARGE(empty). In off, only2146304bytes (~2.047MiB) of that original address range remained mapped; the rest was absent from the full vmmap. This difference explains most of the observed RSS/footprint gap in these new runs.
conclusions.pose_capacity: Both methods add approximately384MiB resident at first pose creation (float conversion temporary plus retained CPU and Metal images). The method-dependent gap is already present beforehand; pose creation overlaps the retained freed pages rather than creating an extra cache-sized live allocation.
conclusions.relief_not_fix: All end-of-run relief calls and both post-decode relief controls returned0 with no immediate memory change. Do not adopt pressure_relief as a demonstrated fix.
conclusions.historical_limit: Original stage29 processes recorded peak/current RSS only. This reproduces and identifies a matching mechanism now, but cannot retroactively prove that every byte of the original88.20MiB delta had this exact cause.
conclusions.scope: This is the native benchmark loader path, which converts even grayscale PNG through RGB888. It is not proof every GUI or camera-source path has this allocation.
conclusions.next_low_risk_direction: A later isolated change can avoid the RGB888 intermediate for verified grayscale inputs while preserving exact source pixel bytes; validate separately. No such algorithm/loader change was made here.
